title: Sun with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- Sun rays -->
    <g fill='#FFB300'>
      <polygon points='50,4 54,18 46,18'/>
      <polygon points='50,96 54,82 46,82'/>
      <polygon points='4,50 18,54 18,46'/>
      <polygon points='96,50 82,54 82,46'/>
      <polygon points='17,17 26,27 20,31'/>
      <polygon points='83,17 80,31 74,27'/>
      <polygon points='17,83 20,69 26,73'/>
      <polygon points='83,83 74,73 80,69'/>
    </g>
    <!-- Sun body -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='#FFD54F'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- Face -->
    <!-- Eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#5D4037'/>
    <!-- Eye shine -->
    <circle cx='40.5' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
    <circle cx='62.5' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
    <!-- Smile -->
    <path d='M36 56 Q50 72 64 56' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- Cheeks -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='53' r='4' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='53' r='4' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
</svg>
